messages:
ada.design: Quick accessibility pass on the Models grid. Found four small but actionable issues while keyboarding + screen reader checks. Posting repros and suggested fixes.
michael.frontend: thanks! paste them here and Ill pick up the fixes.
ravi.a11y: high-level: sync DOM focus with visual selection, ensure per-row action buttons are in the tab sequence even with virtualization, remove duplicated header announcements, and raise pill contrast.
ada.design: 1) Arrow key navigation highlights rows but doesn't move actual DOM focus. The keyboard focus ring disappears when using j/k or arrow keys.
  repro: open Console > Models, press Down Arrow twice; highlight moves but focus remains on previous element.
  suggested fix: when selection changes, call element.focus() on the newly selected row and use :focus-visible for keyboard-only outlines.
michael.frontend: we were toggling aria-selected without moving DOM focus. I'll update the keyboard handler to focus the row and add focus-visible styles.
ravi.a11y: good. Use tabindex=0 on the row or make the row content a semantic focusable element.
ada.design: 2) The kebab (More) button is skipped in tab order for many virtualized rows. Tabbing jumps past until the row is interacted with.
  repro: Tab through the page; several kebabs are not tabbable until row is focused/rendered.
  suggestion: keep the action button rendered as a focusable element (tabindex=0) even when virtualization optimizes visual clones; mark visual-only clones aria-hidden but preserve the tabbable control.
michael.frontend: virtualization complicates this but I'll ensure a persistent tabbable control per row and toggle visual-only attributes for clones.
sophia.qa: I'll add an E2E that tabs across 12 rows and asserts each kebab receives focus.
ada.design: 3) Screen readers announce the column header twice on the first cell (e.g., "Name, Models, row 3 of 12, Name").
  repro: VoiceOver on mac and NVDA on Windows both repeat the header for some cells.
  likely cause: redundant aria-labelledby pointing at the header plus native th relationship.
ravi.a11y: audit labelledby chains. Remove redundant aria-labelledby on the cell and prefer aria-describedby for extra notes. Ensure correct role pairing (role="row" + role="gridcell") if using grid semantics.
michael.frontend: will remove the extra labelledby and re-run SR checks.
ada.design: 4) Status pills (experimental/deprecated) are low contrast at small sizes (~2.7:1). They look faint.
  suggested: use a darker text token (e.g., --status-pill-text) or increase weight to reach at least 3:1 (prefer 4.5:1).
michael.frontend: I'll propose token changes and show a before/after in the PR.
ravi.a11y: small copy/accessibility nit: kebab aria-label is just "More". Use a descriptive label like "More actions for <model name>" so each control is contextual for SR users.
michael.frontend: agree, will set aria-label dynamically.
ada.design: can we prioritize the focus + kebab tab fixes this sprint? they block keyboard workflows.
michael.frontend: yes. I'll split into two PRs: (A) focus sync + kebab tabbability (P0) due in 3 business days, (B) pill tokens + SR attribute cleanup (P1) next week.
ravi.a11y: ping me on PR A for review; I'll add a compact checklist to the component docs.
sophia.qa: I'll add the keyboard/VO tests once PRs land.
ada.design: thanks team  I'll attach screenshots of token suggestions in the follow-up.
